{"consolidated_memory":"**File: storage/blob/uploader.rs (storage side, Rust)**

Two separate partial upload issues in the uploader, both manifesting with the same signal but different root causes and fixes:

**OCCASION 1: 2026-07-13 — Listener not removed on teardown**
- Trigger: Only affected accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Problem: Partial upload in the uploader
- Signal: A final part that never gets acknowledged
- Root cause: A listener registered but never removed
- Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR: #8352 on branch fix/partial-upload-3
- Repro: Upload the 40 MB fixture over a throttled link
- Test coverage: Module test block in storage/blob/uploader.rs
- Result: Job finished in 54 minutes instead of 1 hour

**OCCASION 2: 2026-07-20 — Cache entry not invalidated on write**
- Trigger: Only when two requests raced on the same key
- Problem: Partial upload in the uploader
- Signal: A final part that never gets acknowledged
- Root cause: A cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR: #9697 on branch fix/partial-upload-4
- Repro: Upload the 40 MB fixture over a throttled link
- Test coverage: Module test block in storage/blob/uploader.rs
- Result: Reclaimed 21 GB of blob storage"}
